buildOverrides.why: efsim zmdlogs fit-build (2026-11-23), with Hard 27's logged resistances (11: packages/data/src/enemyFacts.ts LOGGED_RESISTANCES): as exported 0 of 21 landed hits within ±1 (every hit ×0.9389: her ATK about 6% high, open-problems "Hard 27"); weapon level 80 alone fits 21 of 21 (21 clean, median ×1.0000) (her weapon's skills [4, 6, 6] are below 9, so the breakthrough stage doesn't pin level 90: docs/accuracy-plan.md "The weapon's level"). The pair with 1 attribute node, level 86 and a food fits as well but needs three inputs; 99fb3c35fda2 (same player, same weapon) fits level 80 too.

efsim zmdlogs fit-build (2026-11-23), with Hard 27's logged resistances: as exported 0 of 23 landed hits within ±1 (every hit ×0.5897, the ×0.655 open-problems "Hard 27" had before the resistances); weapon level 20 alone fits 14 of 23 (14 of 20 clean, median ×1.0012). Its skills [2, 1, 6] (the first two well below 9) fit a weapon at a low breakthrough stage, which the export doesn't give (its level is written as 90). The other 6 clean misfits aren't explained.
